title: Archive extraction boundary with late alias and atomicity constraints

turns.prompt: A package import occasionally writes files outside its requested extraction directory when processing a ZIP uploaded by a tenant. Read README.md, reproduce the failure, identify the end-to-end cause, and propose the smallest fix. Do not edit files yet.

Security owners confirmed additional boundary rules: ZIP names may use Windows backslashes, drive prefixes, or UNC forms; symlink members and pre-existing symlink path components must be rejected; case/Unicode aliases, duplicate normalized paths, and file-directory collisions are invalid; the limit counts total uncompressed bytes; and any validation failure must leave the destination unchanged. Revise the plan and explicitly invalidate any extractall, string-prefix, validation-while-writing, compressed-size, or single-platform normalization proposal.
Approved: implement the smallest complete product fix, add deterministic regression tests if needed, run the complete public suite, and preserve operator_note.txt and all existing test authority.
